title: What you missed at Resend Forward
summary: Resend Forward was a special conference dedicated to the craft of building high-quality software.
body_markdown:
Today, we gathered with a special group of builders, developers, designers, and creators to celebrate the obsession of building high-quality software.


Between sessions at Resend Forward


What you missed at Resend Forward:


- Watch the stream
- Keynote announcements


- 1. Inboxes
- 2. Forge
- 3. Resend for Nonprofits


- What others are saying
- Join a team that cares


## Watch the stream


The entire event was live-streamed and you can watch the replay back now.


## Keynote announcements


While at Forward, we took the opportunity to announce several items.


### 1. Inboxes


We announced Inboxes. **Create inboxes programmatically** , receive email, and work with conversations. Ready for your agents and your teams to work together.


[Inboxes Create shared inboxes, connect your own agents, and build workflows around email. resend.com/products/inboxes](https://resend.com/products/inboxes)


Available now for[every Resend user](https://resend.com/inboxes) .


### 2. Forge


We announced our **own Mail Transfer Agent (MTA)** , delivering from IP blocks we own on infrastructure we control end-to-end. Built for speed, deliverability, and reliability.


[Resend Forge Our own Mail Transfer Agent (MTA), delivering from IP blocks we own and operate. Built for speed and deliverability. resend.com/features/forge](https://resend.com/features/forge)


Available now.[Activate your domain on Forge today](https://resend.com/domains) .


### 3. Resend for Nonprofits


We announced **Resend for Nonprofits** . Registered nonprofits can now get **50% off paid plans** , so more of their budget goes to the mission.


[Resend for Nonprofits You change the world. We make sure your emails get there, at a nonprofit price. resend.com/nonprofits](https://resend.com/nonprofits)


Available now.[Apply today](https://resend.com/nonprofits/apply) .


## What others are saying


We were joined by so many special speakers and attendees. Here's how they experienced Resend Forward.


[Brian](https://x.com/thebriankerr) shared the morning at Resend Forward.


[Christopher](https://x.com/BurnedChris) loved[Aaron Francis's](https://x.com/aarondfrancis) message that opportunity lies in taking on the pain for others.


[Josef](https://x.com/josefbender_) found plenty of insights in[Jonni's](https://x.com/jonnilundy) interview with[Cristina Cordova](https://x.com/cjc) .


[Tony](https://x.com/thisistonydang) enjoyed[Adam Stacoviak's](https://x.com/adamstac) podcast recording with[Taylor Otwell](https://x.com/taylorotwell) where they touched on how MCP makes tools more accessible to non-developers.


[Aileen](https://x.com/aileenvl/) was a fan of[Dave's](https://x.com/davekiss) performance as he gave a eulogy for the software engineer.


Thank you to everyone who made it such a special day.


## Join a team that cares


The best software comes from people who care deeply about their craft. We're hard at work building a team that thinks about building software with a heightened level of care and attention to detail.


If the message of Resend Forward resonates with you, come **build with us** .


[We're hiring](https://resend.com/careers) .


Resend Team at Resend Forward 2026
